error.title: Something went wrong
error.body: We couldn't load this right now. Check your connection and try again.

tabs.scanA11yHint: Opens the camera to identify a plant

garden.title: My Garden
garden.emptyBody: Scan a plant or add one manually to start tracking its growth, care and progress.

community.title: Community
community.emptyTitle: Your feed is about to sprout
community.emptyBody: Posts from growers you follow and trending green wins will appear here.

care.title: Care
care.subtitle: Watering, feeding and more
care.emptyBody: Tasks from your plants' care schedules will appear here, with reminders at the time you choose.

profile.title: Profile
profile.guestBody: Sign-in arrives in Phase 2. Your posts, public garden, saved posts and scan history will live here.
profile.devMenuHint: Component gallery, route index and API status

scan.title: Scanner
scan.body: Live camera, multi-angle capture and the Identify, Diagnose and Toxicity modes arrive in Phase 3.

onboarding.title: Welcome
onboarding.body: Three swipeable intro slides — identify plants, smart reminders, share your green wins — then “Get started”.

permissions.title: Permissions
permissions.body: Friendly explanation cards for camera (required for scanning) and notifications (watering reminders).

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.body: Continue with Apple, Google or email.

verifyCode.title: Enter code
verifyCode.body: 6-digit one-time code with auto-advance and a 30-second resend timer.

profileSetup.title: Set up your profile
profileSetup.body: Avatar, display name, unique @username, climate zone and experience level.

scanProcessing.title: Analyzing
scanProcessing.body: Blurred photo backdrop, animated leaf ring and rotating status messages while the AI works.

scanResult.title: Plant report
scanResult.body: Identification, safety for people, children and pets, usefulness, care guide and growing timeline.

scanHistory.title: Scan history
scanHistory.body: Past scans grouped by date, with search and Toxic / Edible / Diagnoses filters.

plantNew.title: Add plant
plantNew.body: Photo → species → details → AI-suggested care schedule → review.

plantDetail.title: Plant
plantDetail.body: Growth progress, and Overview / Care / Journal / Health sections.

journalNew.title: New journal entry
journalNew.body: Growth photo, note and tag (new leaf, first flower, harvest…).

plantSchedule.title: Care schedule
plantSchedule.body: Task frequencies, reminder time and seasonal adjustments.

postNew.title: New post
postNew.body: Pick and crop photos, write a caption, link a plant and choose a category.

postDetail.title: Post
postDetail.body: Full post with comments, one level of replies and @mentions.

userProfile.title: Profile
userProfile.body: Another grower's posts and public garden, with Follow.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.body: Likes, comments, replies, follows, mentions and care reminders.

search.title: Search
search.body: Plants, posts and users, with recent searches and trending hashtags.

settings.title: Settings
settings.body: Account, notifications, privacy, units, language, help and about.

settingsAccount.title: Account
settingsAccount.body: Email, sign-in methods and account deletion.

settingsNotifications.title: Notifications
settingsNotifications.body: Care reminders on/off and time, community activity.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: This screen doesn't exist. Let's get you back to your garden.

dev.title: Developer
dev.routesHint: Jump to any screen, including placeholders

sample.remindersHint: Push notification at your preferred time
sample.dialogBody: Its care schedule and journal will be removed. This can't be undone.
sample.sheetBody: Water when the top 2–3 cm of soil feel dry. Basil prefers evenly moist soil; avoid soggy roots.
sample.cardBody: Basil is a member of the mint family and can be propagated from cuttings in a glass of water.
